balls.text: that is a full-toss and Pathan swings it away and that has been caught a few yards in front of the boundary at deep square-leg. Pathan waited for the umpire to call it a no-ball but he does not.
slower, good length and he gives himself room, belts it through the covers for a single. Pathan's back.
pitched right up and Pathan gave it his all, goes to long-off for a run.
second ball to Yusuf and he has slogged it over mid-wicket for a six! Is this really a slow pitch?

gone, caught! Finally they hold on to a good catch, but that is a strange shot coming from a batsman who has been hitting them so well in front of the wicket. Tries to paddle sweep it away, does not hit the middle of the bat and it has been caught at short fine-leg.
good length, on the leg side and he can only nudge it away to the leg side for a single
pitched right up, and driven back to the bowler, fielded by the bowler on his follow-through.
Watch out people! Too many slower balls here and Kallis again needed to only wait for it and he has smashed it over the deep mid-wicket region for a six, into the crowds too.

Oh oh! Gambhir went for the six over long-off, it was the right delivery to attempt it as well, pitched up with just the right amount of width but the timing went slightly off and that is caught at long-off. End of an excellent innings from the captain.
pitched right up to the block-hole and Kallis can only defend to the off-side.
And Kallis gets another straight six, over long-off in fact, pitched up and Kallis has dumped it over the fielder for a six.
slower one outside the off stump and he tries it guide it through the short third-man region but does not get it off the middle and they take a single.
slower one and cut to point, there was no third-man in place and would have gone to the fence had Gayle not intervened.
pitched right up to the bat and he can only manage to dab it away to point for a single
bouncer attempted and Gambhir wanted to go for it before he decided it was too high, the umpire also thought so.
pitched right up to the bat and driven down the ground for a single
full-toss and driven down the ground for a couple of runs.
outside the off-stump, pitched up and probably slower, the batsman goes over the covers, misses hitting the gap but it does not carry either.
shortish but angling into the body and it is pulled away for a single.
good length and Kallis plays it away to the off side for a single.
Now that is off the middle, pitched right up to the bat and Kallis teed off from the spot, it has gone to over where the control room is...it was a big six alright.
outside the off stump, cut away to the off-side for a single

what? Six again? It was a short ball alright and Gambhir was waiting for it too, but that hardly looked like it was from the meat of the bat, Gambhir gave it his full and it carries over deep square-leg
yorker length, one of the few that we have seen today and it is driven to long-on for a single.
slower and shorter from Harshal and it is pulled away for a single
driven away to the covers but fielded well.
cut away to the covers for a single.
a poor, poor ball, a full-toss and it has been dispatched by a man who is making them large here. Six over square-leg.
goes down the pitch after it has been pitched up, a bit of a clumsy effort from Vettori and they take a single.
pitched right up on the leg stump and played away to short fine-leg for a single
pitched right up and driven to long-off to give it back to Gambhir.

short ball from Zaheer and Gambhir waits on it, and smacks India's lading bowler for a six over deep mid-wicket! The field on the off side was up in the circle and Gambhir still gets it over the leg side.
slower and shorter this and Kallis dabs it to the third-man region for another single.
slower from round the wicket, a late cut attempted again from Kallis but misses, well kept from the wicket-keeper.
yorker-length, angling into the batsman and driven to deep mid-wicket for a single
slower and it almost did not arrive. Kallis awaited for some time before late-dabbing it to third-man.
round the wicket, width and Kallis goes for a cut, takes a top edge but goes through the slips and for a four!
slower, shorter and Gambhir wanted to go for a pull, but does not for some reason and allows it to go through to the wicket-keeper.
goes down the track and plays it through the leg side. He is rotating the strike rather well.
goes on the back foot and he plays it away to the short fine-leg for a single
cut away, another slower ball, and they easily get a couple.
outside the off-stump in the hope that it would be called a wide, but it was within the line. Slower one as well.
on the stumps, short of length and played away to the off side for a single
driven through to long-off for another single.
cuts away, rather a cute shot, and they get a single.

Dropped? Misfielded for sure and it rolls over! Tries to slog sweep, the slowness of the ball beats him, he still goes for the shot and it lands between the long-on and deep mid-wicket, Vinay Kumar dived to his left and it went through...difficult to call it dropped. Zaheer Khan should have fielded that one while covering Vinay Kumar but he does not bend down in time.
nudged away to the leg-side for a single by Kallis. He will keep doing this till he needs to hit out.
uses his feet yet again and drills it through the covers for a single
on the middle stump, driven through to leg-side for a single
pitched right up on the off stump and drilled to the cover fielder.
and he has hit his second six of the game, lofted over mid-wicket for a six. Used his feet to come down the track, gave himself room and deposits it over the boundary.
slows it down, flights it up and Kallis mis-hits it, in the air for a while but in the gap through the covers.
tries to sweep, gets a top-edge which almost carries to short fine-leg.
missed! Run-out missed and that takes Gambhir to his half-century. 13th in the IPL. Taps it to the leg-side and took off, Kallis responded but he was far away, the throw was wide of the keeper.
bowled up to the batsman, driven stylishly to long off for a run
on the leg-stump and tries to play it away to the leg-side, hits the pads and rolls over.
on the off-stump and driven through to long-off for a single.
pitched up and driven back to the bowler.
bowled this time! He was trying to cut deliveries from the stump, and was getting away but this time it was pitched further up, gets an inside edge on to the stumps.
Wohoaa! Drilled through the covers and that has gone for four. Was pitched up and he gave it his all.
pitched right up and that is swept hard, through the deep square-leg region for a four. McCullum's coming into his own...
outside the off and cut away for a single
slower ball, waits on it and cuts it away to the right of the deep point fielder and they come back for a second.
slower ball and he goes down the track and tries to hit it over the bowler, gets an inside edge and trickles through the fine, fine-leg for a four.
pitched on the length, comes into the batsman, who defends and wants to take off, but it goes back to the bowler.
short ball, slower, cut away to the left of Dilshan at point and they are able to get away for a single. That was well fielded.
bang! Six! What a shot! Gambhir rocks back and slogs it over deep mid-wicket for a six! That was as good as slogs comes!
again a full-pitcher and McCullum drives it back to the left of Vettori, who fields it on his follow through.
pitched right up and he drives it back to the bowler
short, on the back foot and played out in the covers.
and this time it is a shimmy down the track and smashed away behind the bowler!
wasn't really short but it was slow and that allowed the batsman to rock back and smack it over deep mid-wicket for a four!
pitched right up, driven back and there is a bit of a misfield but no harm done.
short this time and flicked away to the deep fine-leg fielder for a single. 10 from that over.
on the back-foot, tried to defend but hits the pads. Loud appeal from the bowler but it was hitting him outside the off-stump
reverse swept away for a four! It was not actually a sweep, more of a short ball and he hit it with a reverse bat so to say.
played away gently to the leg-side for a single.
tossed up and Gambhir comes down the pitch, drives but back to the bowler.
shortish, outside the off-stump and Gambhir has cut it away through the point region for a four! Races away to 41.

shortish yet again and for a change it is McCullum who gets into the act! Pulled away and goes through to the wide long-on region, should have been a couple but Zaheer Khan makes an absolute mess of it and it rolls over to the fence.
goes towards his leg-stump, and dabs it away to the covers for a single.
short again and he went for another pull stroke, this time straight to the fielder, Gayle at mid-wicket.
slower one, outside the off-stump and he tries to guide it to the third-man region, the ball turns away and beats the outside edge.
short and he has gone on to his back-foot and smacked it over the mid-wicket region for a four! This is too slow a pitch to be bowling such half-trackers...
goes down the track, gets an inside edge and narrowly misses the stumps. De Villiers dives to his right and stops it.
quicker, pitched right up to the bat and McCullum just about manages to dig it out.
pitched up and Gambhir comes down the track and drives it to long-on for a single.
full-toss and hammered away through the deep square-leg region for a four. Poor ball, well hit.
on the front-foot, opens the face, defends to the short point fielder and runs away for a single
again on the back-foot and driven to the short cover fielder. Not got his timing yet has McCullum.
pitched full from the spinner and he still goes on to the back-foot, does not get it through.
short ball and Gambhir almost holes out! Tries to pull it away yet again, but fails to get the timing right and the ball lands to the left of Zaheer at mid-on.
goes down the pitch and driven to short cover where Kohli, who was speaking with the commentators, fields well!
on the off-stump, gets the leading edge and drops short of the cover fielder.
short ball and Gambhir continues to flay this attack, sways around and pulls it away to backward square-leg for a four!
short ball, outside the off-stump and McCullum goes after it, plays the pull stroke and it is fielded well by Vettori at wide mid-on.
short of good length, pushed to the covers for no run.
pitched fuller, this time Gambhir remains on the back-foot and plays it away to the leg-side. 10 from the over.
goes down the pitch yet and driven to the wide long-on region, Gambhir calls him back for a second and they run well for it...
pitched very full on his legs and McCullum digs it out to the leg-side for a single.
flighted ball, outside the off-stump and driven to mid-off for a single.
comes down yet again and swept it through to mid-wicket for a four! Bisects the deep square and long-on well.
this time Gambhir comes down the wicket and takes it on the full, driven to the fielder at covers.
and another one down the leg-side.
pitched on middle but turns towards the leg-side...
length ball and defended on the front-foot. End of a costly pair of overs from Zaheer.
down the leg-side, short of length, it deviates a little and goes further down the leg-side for a wide.
punched off the back-foot to the fielder at short cover, fielded.
on the back-foot and defended back
dropped again! They are catching the disease! Over the wicket, tries to cut it and it goes to the left of gully, Gayle, who does go for it, but fails to get it.
four more! After giving him width on two successive occasions, he tries to compensate by trying to cramp him, drifts down the leg-side and it is nudged away for a four!

Dropped! If he had caught that, it would have been a ripper! Gambhir got width again and went for a slash, the top-edge went to the left of Harshal Patel at third-man who ran and dived and caught it...before it popped out and went to the fence.
another one that is short of length, goes on to the back foot and punches to Kohli, who misfields but apart from a thought of a single, they get nothing.
on his pads, Gambhir brings his foot down the ground and taps it away to the leg side for a single
on to the back foot, driven to long-off for a single.Gambhir's back on strike. Left-handed against the ball coming in...
shortish, driven to the covers for another dot.
Ooooh! That turned from Vettori, who usually relies on variations than turn, beats outside the off-stump
pitched on the middle, turning slightly away and defended into the covers.
cut away and that has gone all the way through point for a four! He was playing only his first delivery, Zaheer was coming round the wicket and Gambhir gets some width, placed well.
and a shortish ball yet again, goes on to the back-foot and towards the off-stump, nudged away for a single this time.
on the pads and he nudges it away yet again, this time through square-leg for a couple
slower one, pitched short and it turns viciously away after pitching, through to the wicket-keeper
back of length yet again, not too much bounce, goes on to the back-foot and defends it back.
short of length, tucked away to the leg-side and that has beaten the short fine-leg! They have brought in the fine-leg this early...
short, bouncer and the batsman allows it go through, wide not called and Kolkata have won with some ease here.
edged and it has been given out, caught behind. Outside the off-stump and Gayle wanted to go for the drive, takes the edge and McCullum takes a good catch.
drilled to the cover fielder. He has 86 to his name.
pitched up and swung away straight for a four! The Orange Cap has changed hands.
slower one and he swings it hard, misses and it hits him on the inside of the thigh.
full toss and driven to the covers for a single.

and that is the third six of the over! Power hitting as you would expect as well, and I think Bhatia tried to push the ball up to the bat this over, instead of the short of good length he was bowling.
and that has been deposited again into the long-on crowds. Wonder where were those shots earlier?
full-toss and the sleeping giant has woken up finally. Drilled through the covers for a four.
That is a Gayle special, needed one hand to swing it over long-on for a six. That really went deep into the crowd.
pitched up and drilled to the covers. No run.
slows it down, floats it up and it is swept away for a single.
Vettori tried to play it inside out, Narine slowed it down and he could only manage to chip it away to the off side.
pitched right up and driven to long-off for a single.
well bowled yet again, turning away from the batsman, again fails to read him.
slog swept away by the captain to deep mid-wicket for a single. It is over 30 now.
bowled him! Gone off a quicker one. He was on the back-foot after seeing it was a shorter one but yet again, he fails to read which way was it going to turn and it goes through his defences.
nudged away to the leg side for a single
shorter from Kallis and that is short too, tries to pull it away but can get it only to square-leg for a single. Gayle's only jogging now, is there some fitness issue?
and suddenly a poor ball, and even poorer keeping. Down the leg side, gets a feather, on the bounce to the keeper who misses it.
and now he goes on to the back foot by clearing his foot, in attempt to hit it over long-on. Excellent bowling after the first two fours.
goes down the track, Kallis slows it down, pulls the length up and Gayle has a swing at it. Misses.
slower on the pads and the rather languid Gayle has flicked it away to the leg-side for a four. Half-century for Gayle. Can he smack all of them to the boundary?
goes down the track, takes it on the full and this is a lofted drive over wide long-on for a four.
full pitched yet again and drilled through the covers but fielded well by sweeper to usher in the Time-Out
Oooh! Finally a shot in anger and a lot of it! Full-toss from Lee and that is smashed over long-on, misses the fielder and cleans up the laptop in front of Brijesh Patel!
full-toss and that is punched through the covers for a single. The required rate is 23.
pitched right up and quicker, Gayle can only drive it to long-off. Difficult ball to hit.
shorter and failed to rise too much, on the pads and what does Agarwal do? Pushes it to the leg side for another single.
yorker outside the off stump and he digs it out, for a single to third-man.
short of a good length, on the back foot and, yawn, defended.
pitched right up and Gayle wanted to drive at it, and an inside edge gets a single.
ripper from Narine! Pitched outside the leg stump and turns away from the batsman, beats him!
short from Narine and the batsman had absolutely no idea which was it going to turn. Dabs it to the off side for a single.
on the back foot and defended on the off side.
quickish leggie, tried to play it on the front foot and beaten all ends.
played away to the off side for a single.
and Gayle continues to dab it away to the off-side for a single. He wasn't selected in the Test squad for their tour of England. Just saying.
yorker-length, and another one bowled really quick, at 139.4 km/hr, driven to long-off for a single.
pitched up, quick and driven to extra-cover.
outside the off-stump, some width for the batsman and he cuts it away to the fine third-man for four.
starts with a bouncer, and it is a quicker one! Agarwal ducks under it.
pitched right up to the bat and driven to long-on for a single.

but Bhatia has his revenge off the very next ball, slower one outside the off-stump and Tiwary wanted to go over long-on, it gripped a little and he ended up slicing it to point where the captain takes a simple catch.
and this time it is Tiwary who has deposited the ball over long-off for a six! Slower but this was pitched up, unlike the previous ones and he has been smacked.
slower one and cuts it with full force but to the deep cover fielder. Only a single.
it was bound to happen sometime and it finally has, shorter from Bhatia and Gayle goes on to the back-foot and dismisses it over long-on.
full-toss and he tries to hit it over, but can get it only to long-on for a single.
shorter one from Narine to Tiwary who fails to hit it into the crowd, not that he attempted to do that anyway which is a bit of a surprise. Single to deep square-leg.
outside the off-stump after it turns away from Gayle and he plays it away to the off-side.
slower, shorter and it keeps really low, the pull shot goes to long-on for a single
shorter and he tries to cut it, but isn't able to get it away
tries to defend on the leg-side but hits his pads and they are off for a single
down the leg-side, no turn and missed, probably hit his pads on the way through to the keeper.
slower one outside the off-stump, kept low and Tiwary only plays it to the covers.
slower yet again and driven to long-off. He is not attempting too many in anger, something that should not be too far away.
yorker length, quicker too and Tiwary just about manages to play it to long-on.
gives himself some room, wanted to go over it, but checks his stroke to that slower one.
slow yet again and defended on the off-side for a single.
swings it away and misses. There was some sort of an appeal from the bowler for a caught-behind but none from the keeper.
shortish yet again and punched back to long-off for a single. Kallis is down on his haunches, probably because of the heat - and a three-over spell!
tries to play this one to the leg side but misses. There has been nothing pitched up to Gayle so far.
short, slow and it climbs over Gayle, who is all of six feet four inches. It was probably a foot over him too.
short and this time Gayle has bludgeoned it away to the deep square-leg region for a four.
pulled away, it was shorter yet again and it goes straight to the deep mid-wicket fielder for a single.
even before he has bowled, Tiwary walks down the track and Kallis sends down a slower bouncer. Misses comfortably.
outside the off-stump, short of length and defended to point
shorter outside the off-stump, cut away to the sweeper fielder for a single
on the front foot and defended. With the run-rate having climbed to almost 13, they will do well to put that stroke out for the next few overs.
shorter and down the leg-side, had he left it alone, it would have been a wide. Instead, he gets some bat on it and it goes to short fine-leg.
moves down the track and then defends it lazily to the leg side for a single. The first of the over.
quicker one and it goes straight through, Gayle was hurried into the stroke.
on the middle, turning away from the left-hander, defended and goes to the short third-man fielder.
Slower one, holds up on the surface and Gayle goes down and defends.
slower, outside the leg-stump and that is tucked away for a single by Gayle. Moves on to 16 off 16.
punched off the back foot by Gayle, to the covers fielder.
bouncer again and that is pulled well to deep square leg for a single.
loud appeal but it seemed to be pitching outside the leg-stump . Slower one and there was a cry from Kallis, but Billy Doctrove rules it not-out, and rightly so.
short and wide and slashed away through the point region for a four! Many more of these needed but at least this is a start.
on his pads, tries to force it through the leg side but goes to short mid-wicket
on the back-foot yet again and played away to the leg side for a single. Only three of his third and 18 off his three.
not pitching it up, Tiwary goes on to his back foot, dabs it to the off side.
on a length and nudged away to the leg-side for a single
defended on the front foot yet again and gets nothing.
slower, a tad shorter and Gayle waits on it before defending on the off side.
on the pads, and nudged away by Tiwary to deep square-leg for a single. Pathan is in his third over.
outside the off-stump and dabbed away to the off-side.
another short one from Kallis and Tiwary goes for the same shot that AB de Villiers went for, goes to wide mid-on for a single!
outside the off-stump, defended on the front foot.
gone first ball for a duck! AB de Villiers gets a short ball from Kallis and wanted to lap it away to the leg-side, gets a top-edge and spoons up easily for the fielder at mid-on!

gone, lbw and Kohli has delivered a mouthful at nobody in particular. It was a good length ball, played from the back foot in an attempt to carve it through the leg-side but misses it and that's hit his pads, given out lbw. Kohli waited for an eternity before trudging off, a scene from the days of Inzamam-ul-Haq.
Fails to get to the ball, technically a chance but too difficult I think. Kohli wanted to go over long-on but did not get the middle of the bat and the fielder runs back but misses.
what an over, just one off the last ball! Again on the back-foot, trying to give himself room and that is played away to square-leg where there is a misfield and they rush off for a single.
on the back foot, the ball gets big on the batsman, who wanted to hit it through the off-side, but gets it to the leg-side.
pitched right up and defended to the leg-side and still no run. A big shot coming...

out, is it? They are appealing for something but the umpire Asad Rauf does not give it out immediately...the two umpires are discussing something! Tried to cut the ball, there was huge turn there into the batsman and the ball came off the inside edge it seems, to the wicket-keeper. The bails are on the floor...the on-field umpire is having a chat with the third umpire, the ball hit the bails off the wicket-keeper's gloves after it looked to have got some bat on to the batsman's pads.
turns into the batsman, who flicks it away to square leg.
outside the off-stump and it keeps low. Kohli wanted to go to the back foot and cut it, but manages to keep the ball out.
opens the face of his bat and plays it away to the third-man region for a single

short of length, rising up to the bat and Kohli just guides it to the point fielder. In fact it was to the left of point, he dived and missed and it has gone for four! Lee has that ' you-got-to-be-kidding-me' look about him.
shortens the length a tad and defends it into the covers.
slower, up to the bat and Kohli leaned so beautifully into it and drove it through wide mid-off...lip-smacking!
quicker on the length and Kohli defends well on the front foot.
slower on and defended back to the bowler.

dropped! No, you cannot do that if you want to win matches, you just cannot! Gayle wanted to go over long-off, got a lot of height and there were four of them coming from everywhere to catch the ball, but fellow West Indian Narine drops a sitter.
pitched up and defended back to the bowler.
pitched up and Gayle gives it the full treatment, it was a full arc of the bat, over deep mid-wicket and into the crowds. Be very careful there in the crowds!
immediately shortens his length, rocks back on to his back-foot and drives it through mid-wicket for a single
driven yet again, more powerfully and to the left of mid-on, not fielded too well and it goes through him for a four.
pitched up to Kohli, who drives it to the covers.
that was on the up, it was actually a short of a good length delivery and Gayle gives it direction through the extra-cover region!
outside the off-stump and change of pace yet again, Gayle only taps it to the covers. Six balls for his two so far.
down the leg-side, quick one and Gayle tried to feather it through to fine-leg, misses the edge and the umpire calls a wide.
outside the off-stump and slower, Kohli went for the drive, but checked the stroke quickly and the outside edge gets him a single to third man.
outside the off stump, punched to the covers and fielded.
good length and Gayle remains back, opens the face of the bat, takes the outside half of the bat through to third-man for a single
outside the off-stump, going away and Gayle allows it to go through to the keeper.

gone, caught! Pathan has eked out the wicket of Dilshan, a big, big one at that. Dilshan went after Pathan in the same manner he had tried to do off the first ball, does not get the middle and lobs it back to mid-off, who takes a good catch.
defended off the front foot, inside edge to square-leg for a single
pitched right up to the batsman and Gayle defends it back to the bowler.
pitched right up, a tad quicker and defended on his front foot.
goes down the track and looks to hit it over the bowler, inside edge to deep square leg for a single
short of length, tapped away to the leg-side but to the fielder.
